description: A double-pipe wind instrument model: two reed-and-bore waveguides sound together, the second offset from the first, so one gate plays a pair of pipes rather than a single voice

params.text: Morphs the reed between a soft and a hard beating shape
Attenuverts the reed CV before it is added to the reed knob
Changes the shape of the bore, which moves the instrument between a cylindrical and a conical register
Attenuverts the bore CV before it is added to the bore knob
Drives the reed harder into its nonlinearity, which brightens the tone and makes it overblow more readily
Attenuverts the drive CV before it is added to the drive knob
Sets how sharply the bore resonates, which is how much the pipe colours the reed
Attenuverts the resonance CV before it is added to the resonance knob
Sets how much breath noise is mixed into the excitation
Attenuverts the air CV before it is added to the air knob
Sets how strong the burst of noise at the start of each note is
Attenuverts the chiff CV before it is added to the chiff knob
Offsets the second pipe from the first, -1 to 1 octaves, which sets the interval between them
Attenuverts the secondary pipe CV before it is added to that knob
Sets how much of the pipe's body resonance is heard alongside the bore
Attenuverts the wood CV before it is added to the wood knob
Sets how hard the pipes are blown, silence to full
Attenuverts the breath CV before it is added to the breath knob
Sets how much vibrato the internal oscillator applies, and scales any external vibrato voltage as well
Transposes both pipes together, -1 to 4 octaves
Transposes the fingering, -1 to 1 octaves, which moves the played note without moving the pipe
Blows both pipes while it is held, which is a gate without a cable
Makes the second pipe sound continuously on each press and stops it on the next, so it drones under the played notes
Sets the output level of both pipes, silence to three times
Attenuverts the volume CV before it is added to the volume knob
Sets how hard the external input excites the pipes, silence to full
Attenuverts the external gain CV before it is added to the external gain knob

inputs.text: Sets the length of the pipe itself as a volt per octave, added to the pipe tuning knob; with nothing patched the finger input falls back to this pitch
Sets the played note as a volt per octave, added to the finger tuning knob; with nothing patched it follows the pipe pitch instead
A gate above 1V blows the pipes; the number of channels here is one of the things that sets how many notes can sound at once
Changes how hard the pipes are blown, scaled by a tenth and added to the breath knob through its attenuverter, the total clamped to the knob's travel
Bends the pitch of both pipes, scaled through the vibrato depth knob, which is what an external vibrato is patched into
Changes the reed shape, scaled by a tenth and added to the reed knob through its attenuverter
Changes the bore shape, scaled by a tenth and added to the bore knob through its attenuverter
Changes the reed drive, scaled by a tenth and added to the drive knob through its attenuverter
Changes the bore resonance, scaled by a tenth and added to the resonance knob through its attenuverter
Changes the amount of breath noise, scaled by a tenth and added to the air knob through its attenuverter
Changes the interval of the second pipe, added to the secondary pipe knob through its attenuverter and clamped to an octave either way
Changes the amount of body resonance, scaled by a tenth and added to the wood knob through its attenuverter
Changes the strength of the note-start noise burst, scaled by a tenth and added to the chiff knob through its attenuverter
A signal fed into the pipes alongside the breath, which lets them be excited by something other than the model's own reed
A rise switches the drone on and the next rise switches it off, which is what the drone button does by hand
Changes the output level, scaled by a tenth and added to the volume knob through its attenuverter, the total clamped to the knob's travel
Changes how hard the external input excites the pipes, scaled by a tenth and added to the external gain knob through its attenuverter

outputs.text: The first pipe, clamped to -10 to 10V; the panel prints MAIN because this is a pipe rather than the left side of a stereo pair
The second pipe, clamped to -10 to 10V; the panel prints SEC. because this is a pipe rather than the right side of a stereo pair
Follows the breath envelope of the first pipe, which rises as the gate opens and falls as it closes
Follows the loudness of the excitation as a root-mean-square envelope

notes: the pipes make no sound until they are blown, by a gate above 1V at the GATE jack or by holding the manual gate button
menu: Tracking (interval preserved) — makes the second pipe follow the played note at the interval set by the secondary pipe control
Two Pipes (fixed registers) — holds the second pipe at its own register instead of following the played note, so the two pipes behave as separate instruments
Waveguide Gain — a slider from 0 to 1.75 setting how much energy each pass round the waveguide keeps, which is how readily the pipe speaks and overblows
Decay (ring-off time) — a slider setting how long a pipe keeps sounding after the breath stops
Attack — a slider setting how quickly the breath envelope rises once the gate goes high
Release — a slider setting how quickly the breath envelope falls once the gate drops
Attack Curve (log - exp) — a slider from -1 to 1 bending the breath envelope's rise between logarithmic and exponential
Release Curve (log - exp) — a slider from -1 to 1 bending the breath envelope's fall between logarithmic and exponential
Rate (Hz) — a slider from 3Hz to 12Hz setting the speed of the internal vibrato
Breath Coupling — a slider setting how far the breath envelope opens the internal vibrato, so vibrato grows with the note rather than running at a fixed depth
Legato — makes a new note glide from the previous pitch instead of jumping, as long as the gate has stayed high
Legato Glide Time (ms) — a slider from 5ms to 80ms setting how long a legato glide takes
Follow Time — a slider setting how quickly the RMS output follows the excitation
Panic: Clear All Energy — silences both pipes at once, which clears a runaway build-up without reloading the patch
